name: optimize-loop
description: Use when the user wants to iteratively improve an artifact under a hard correctness bound while minimizing a measured cost — refactoring a code module to cut complexity while its test suite stays green, OR speeding up a SQL query while it returns the same rows. Each iteration applies one focused change, checks a correctness gate that must pass, measures a metric that must drop, and keeps the change only if both hold, else reverts; loops to a plateau or budget. Not for adding features, fixing bugs, or any change that is allowed to alter behaviour or results.
